lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, with a notable horizontal alignment of 4-5 prominent blobs in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of white blobs to form a distinctive checkerboard-like grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal linear feature is observed on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side, extending from the posterior gill region toward the dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the anterior and basal regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced-out blobs on the lateral flank.
